name: arrow-up
description: A up-facing navigation arrow with a straight shaft and a solid rounded triangular head.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Round 5 completes the eight compass arrows. Rotate the approved Arrow Right straight shaft and V head by -90 degrees about 12,12, uniformly fit centerlines to a 9.15-unit primary half extent, then bake coordinates into source. Reference centerline points before rotation are shaft (4,12) to (20,12) and head (14,6) to (20,12) to (14,18). Centerline fit factor 1.1437500000; keep Regular1.70 unchanged instead of scaling stroke. Top/bottom are the primary pair at exactly2px; left/right stay balanced and preserve natural proportions. Outline keeps an open straight-arm V with .85 round caps and joins. Filled uses the exact .85 capsule around the same shaft and a solid triangle expanded by .85 round exterior corners around those same head vertices. Tips, shoulders and exterior align at Regular1.70; the solid head is the accepted semantic interior exception. No enclosing box, broad curved-head fillet or preview transform. Existing approved Left/Right artwork is preserved. Both new styles await owner review.

review.note: Round 5: new direction derived from the approved Arrow Right family, awaiting owner visual review.
